Questions

Before you grab your seat

Is this medical advice or treatment?

No. It's an educational class. It doesn't diagnose or treat any condition and doesn't create a doctor-patient relationship. If you have concerns about your sleep or health, please speak with your own doctor.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch when it suits you.

Do I need to take the Sleep Goddess Quiz first?

It's not required, but it helps. Take it before class and bring your result.

Who is this class for?

Women who've noticed their nights feel different lately, have read the sleep hygiene lists, and want education from a sleep physician plus a simple evening plan they can start the same night.

What do I get for $17?

The live 60-minute class, live Q&A with Dr Andrea, the full replay, the evening wind-down checklist (PDF) and the Sleep Goddess type guide (PDF).

Script 1 · "What I wish more women knew"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"I'm a sleep physician, and this is the thing I wish more women knew about sleep in midlife."

Body

"Sleep often changes in our forties and fifties, and it's not a willpower problem. Hormones, body temperature and stress can all play a part. Once you understand what's going on, the habits that help start to make sense, and most of them begin hours before bed."

CTA

"I'm teaching a live 60-minute masterclass on exactly this. It's $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to save your seat."

Shot: talking to camera in the white blazer, warm evening light, purple backdrop.

Caption footer: Educational content, not medical advice.

Script 2 · "The sleep hygiene list"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Dark room, no caffeine, no screens. If you've read that list a hundred times, this one's for you."

Body

"Those tips aren't wrong, they're just not the whole picture. In my D.R.E.A.M. Sleep Method I look at the full day, not just the last ten minutes before bed. That's where most of the change happens."

CTA

"I'll walk through it in the D.R.E.A.M. Sleep Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up."

Shot: hold up a printed tip list, fold it away, then talk to camera.

Caption footer: Educational content, not medical advice.

Script 3 · "Your Sleep Goddess type"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Have you found your Sleep Goddess type yet?"

Body

"I created the Sleep Goddess Quiz because no two women sleep the same way. Your type shows where to start. In my live masterclass I'll explain what each type tends to need most, and how to build an evening routine around it."

CTA

"Take the quiz, then join me live for $17. Tap Sign up below."

Shot: on-screen text listing the types as Dr Andrea names each one, then back to camera.

Caption footer: Educational content, not medical advice.
